scope: RecoveryChat optional filename semantic search pack for win32-x64

intentionallyOmitted.name: sharp
intentionallyOmitted.reason: Filename embeddings never process images; the static import is replaced by a fail-closed stub.

intentionallyOmitted.name: adm-zip
intentionallyOmitted.reason: Only the upstream native-binary installer uses it; this pack ships fixed preselected binary files and has no installer.

intentionallyOmitted.name: global-agent
intentionallyOmitted.reason: Only the omitted upstream downloader uses it.

intentionallyOmitted.name: onnxruntime-web
intentionallyOmitted.reason: The optional worker uses the native Windows CPU binding.

verification.runtimeFiles: runtime-manifest.json contains the size and SHA-256 of every file loaded by the curated runtime.
verification.rebuild: prepare-runtime.py downloads only pinned HTTPS sources, verifies their npm SHA-512 integrity, selects regular files without extractall, applies the two documented transformations, and writes a new runtime manifest.
verification.auditLimit: npm audit reports only package-lock.json dependencies. The zero finding for this dependency-free optional package does not scan vendored files and is not proof that the full AI pack is vulnerability-free.
